Why Bay Breeze

Real estate made simple and transparent

We left the classroom to teach real estate—prioritizing education, patience, and zero corporate jargon for every client.

01

Zero Corporate Jargon

We break down every contract, inspection report, and negotiation step in plain English so you always feel confident.

02

Hyper-Local Expertise

Deeply rooted in Alameda, Oakland, and the East Bay waterfronts, we know these neighborhoods block by block.

03

Education Over Pressure

No high-pressure sales tactics here. We host monthly library workshops and guide you at your own pace.

04

Weekend Open House Crawls

Join our fun, community-driven weekend tours to explore neighborhoods and find your dream home together.
